instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value is never fixed but always being redefined — and then tells me the same thing again with the artist's name attached.
instances.why: Line 17 states the abstract property ('indeterminate and continually redefined') that the five-item list has just demonstrated, and line 18 restates that same property as 'an ongoing process of redefinition'; both sit in the same register — the work's standing condition — and share the root 'redefin-' with each other and with line 16's closing clause. Neither adds a mechanism, an object, a participant, or a claim about form that the other lacks, so cutting one costs nothing; I would keep 18, which at least names an agent and sets up line 20.
